integrity: Weight four allows only label multisets 2+2, 2+1+1, or 1+1+1+1. The 2+2 case forces one universal defender in each bipartition class. The 2+1+1 case is possible only when the defender's own side has order two and forces the defender to be universal. The all-one case occurs only on four vertices. These disjoint cases give the exact optimizer count.
scientific_limitations: The scalar quasi-total Roman domination number four for nonstar connected chain graphs is published prior work and is not claimed as new.
The theorem classifies minimum functions rather than all higher-weight quasi-total Roman functions.
Stars and K2 have different published minimum values and are excluded.
Finite exhaustive verification through total order eight is corroborative only.
A differently phrased or non-indexed optimizer enumeration may exist.
title: Minimum quasi-total Roman functions of connected chain graphs
